comment: The rule half of refuse-newer-minor-strict.json. An image of a newer minor version loads (I4) unless a strict object (a rule, a schedule entry) has a member this firmware does not know: then the refusal adds that the image's schema is newer than the firmware reads (from 1.2 on). The case uses minor 99, so it stays newer than every firmware.
